verdict.rationale: No hosted fine-tuning API appears anywhere in DeepSeek's docs. The only support for the story is community reports that DeepSeek releases open weights (V4 Flash native-precision weights, described as accessible for local use and 'open-source'), which in principle can be tuned. missing for 10: a documented hosted fine-tuning API, first-party docs on weight downloads and license terms permitting fine-tuning, a documented fine-tuning guide or recipe, and hands-on corroboration of tuning DeepSeek weights.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune the vendor's models on my own data through a documented self-serve path — hosted fine-tuning API or tunable open weights

citations.quote: very accessible for people running large local models
